background: Melton Mowbray Building Society is a small mutual in Leicestershire, funded by retail savings from its branches and lending on residential, buy-to-let and self-build mortgages.
synthesis: None of the three agencies rates the society. Capital is the weak side against UK building societies: CET1 of 14.2% is in the bottom quarter against the peer median and leverage of 6.0% is a shade under the peer median. Liquidity is very strong, with LCR of 732% and NSFR of 152% both in the top quarter. Since 31 Dec 2022 CET1 has fallen 1.1 points and leverage 0.4 points while LCR has risen 309 points and NSFR 5 points, so the society has built a large liquidity cushion at some cost to capital headroom. The figures run only to 31 Dec 2023, so they are old. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
